name: Reincarnate

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: rare oils worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: a dead Humanoid or a piece of one

summary: Return a dead Humanoid to life in a new adult body of a random species.
text: The creature must have died within the last 10 days and its soul must be willing. It keeps its mind, memories and capabilities, but swaps its species traits for the new body's.
